description: Distritos de Riego activos is a dataset listed in Colombian national open data portal (datos.gov.co), an open data portal (Socrata), published or maintained by Agencia de Desarrollo Rural - ADR, Bogotá D.C.. Presenta la relación de distritos de riego construidos a nivel nacional. Esta información se encuentra bajo la Licencia Colombia Abierta – CC BY 4.0. Puede ser utilizada libremente, citando la fuente. Coverage: Colombia. The portal files it under the publisher Agencia de Desarrollo Rural - ADR, Bogotá D.C.. It offers 2 resource(s) in CSV, JSON. The portal files it under the category Agricultura y Desarrollo Rural. The portal shows 2025-10-15 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-SA-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support irrigation network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-datos-gov-co-portal.
